questions.question: The tool used to tighten and loosen a screw is called?
questions.solution: __Screwdriver:__ • A screwdriver is a tool, manual or powered, used for turning screws. • A typical simple screwdriver has a handle and a shaft, ending in a tip the user puts into the screw head before turning the handle. • **A screwdriver is used for tightening or loosening the screw.** • A round rod with a flat end, having a handle at the other end is called a screwdriver. • The length of a screwdriver is measured excluding the handle. • The length of a screwdriver varies from 50 millimeters i.e. 2” to 18”. • A screwdriver has three main parts, as shown in the figure. **Parts of Screwdriver:** • Handle • Shank • Blade

questions.question: Which among the following is ***not*** a basic physical components of a painting?

options.text: Ground on which the painting is done.
Colours that make up the painting
Tools like screw driver and pliers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tools like screwdrivers and pliers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The following are the basic physical components of a painting.**
 
• **The ground on which the painting is done:**
 
 
• Right through history in India, rock faces and caves, walls of the home, the floor, the threshold, a palm leaf, a piece of wood, cloth or even the palm of a hand was used as a background to paint.
 
• In India, we have many imaginative names for each type of painted surface in all our languages.
 
 
 
• **Colours that make up the painting:**
 
 
• **​**Colours for a painting can be organic or inorganic depending on how they are obtained or made.
 
 
 
• **Adhesive or glue:**
 
 
• A painting is said to be permanent if an adhesive is used to fix it to the ground.
 
• For centuries, in western countries (Europe), oil was used to fix colours and the paintings were called oil paintings.
 
• When water is used it is called watercolour paintings.
 
 
 
• **Tools to apply colours to the ground:**
 
 
• **​Painting is done with a variety of implements or tools made from natural materials such as:**
 
 
• **​**Thin sticks stripped from long grasses.
 
• Brushes made of birdís feathers, squirrelís and catís hair.
 
• Bamboo slivers are buried in the ground until they become fibrous.
 
• Textures are obtained by using combs, toothbrushes and leaves.
 
• The effect of a spray of colour is made by blowing coloured organic liquids through a blower.

questions.solution:

(ii) The length of pipe.

(iii) Time taken to close the valve.

questions.question: Which tap wrench is used for tapping small sizes of taps in restricted places?
questions.solution:
__Explanation:__

Tap wrenches

 
• Tap wrenches are used to align and drive the hand taps correctly into the hole to be threaded.
 
• Tap wrenches are of different types, such as
 
 
• double-ended adjustable wrench,
 
• T- handle tap wrench
 
• solid type tap wrench
 
 

Double-ended adjustable tap wrench or bar type tap wrench 

 
• This is the most commonly used type of tap wrench.
 
• It is available in various sizes- 175, 250, 350 mm long.
 
• These tap wrenches are more suitable for large diameter taps and can be used in open places where there is no obstruction to turn the tap.
 
• It is important to select the correct size of the wrench.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc473314799fa5bd2079f11e35134ef8b64bacf88ccfb5d7af8f4bb285c8a506.png] 

T- handle tap wrench

 
• These are small, adjustable chucks with two jaws and a handle to turn the wrench.
 
• **This tap wrench is useful to work in restricted places and is turned with one hand only.**
 
• Most suitable for smaller sizes of taps.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63fe17204d72e56f77bcbdbc832c47c46a7e0916793f3159fd31f04cd42c09a9.png] 

Solid type tap wrench 

 
• These wrenches are not adjustable.
 
• They can take only certain sizes of taps.
 
• This eliminates the use of the wrong length of the tap wrenches, and thus prevents damage to the taps.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92e68438ba4ec3a77fe343b58a2c4fe22d224857fbf4584819ff57c7e1ecee23.png]

questions.question: The instrument used for drawing parallel lines at any angle ______
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

**Clinograph** is an adjustable set-square and is used to draw parallel lines **at any angle.** The two sides of clinograph are fixed at 90 and the third side can be adjusted at any desired angle.

**Set square**

Types of the set square: 

 
• Thirty-sixty set square: The 30-60 set square has three edges, one of which forms 90 and other edges forming angles of 30 and 60 with the other sides.
 
• Forty-five set square: The 45 set square is similar to the 30-60 set square, but its edge forms an isosceles triangle in which two of the angles are of 45 each and other one’s 90.

**Use of set square:**

 
• The set square are used for drawing all straight lines except the horizontal lines which are usually drawn with T-square.
 
• The perpendicular lines or the lines at 15,30,45,60,75,90,105 to the horizontal can be drawn by using the set-squares.
 
• The set-squares can also be used for drawing parallel and perpendicular lines to any given line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaebfe4619fd7362e4be341a7903d390fe6ea5f70671d7d48c14ac96e4aaa4eb.png] ​

**T square**

T-square is made of hard quality wood such as teak or mahogany. There are two essential pars of T-square, namely the stock and the blade.

**Use of T-square:**

 
• The T-square is mainly used for drawing horizontal lines.
 
• The T-square is used as a base for drawing various angles with the help of set squares.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/833d8d2f10a892d6c933309a66e1c3cccc93f7ffbe8306773545412166180b4e.png] ​

**Scale**

All measurements of lengths or distances on a drawing are made with the scales. The scale is measuring stick, graduated with different divisions to represent the corresponding actual distances according to some fixed proportion.

**Use of Scale:**

 
• It is used to prepare or enlarge size drawings
 
• It is used to set of dimensions
 
• It is used to measure distances directly

 [IMAGE: https://storage.googleapis.com/tb-img/production/19/08/Mistake Point.png] 

**Clinograph **is used to draw parallel lines **at any angle** and **the set-squares **are used for drawing parallel and perpendicular lines **to any given line.**

questions.question: The movable jaw of bench vice is not moving even though the spindle is turned. It is due to the reasons that ________.

options.text: Fixed and moveable jaw are overtight
Thread on spindle are slightly worn out

questions.solution:
Bench vice is a work holding device used to hold work for such operations as sawing, filing, chipping, tapping, threading etc.

Vices have two parallel jaws, one fixed and the other movable, threaded in and out by a screw and lever.

The fixed jaw remains stationary and only the movable jaw moves and grips the workpiece when spindle is tightened.

When spindle pin is broken, the movable jaw will not move.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f67117ca7f614094b84d1b9dc6e133d257be55b1b6617d423e219c969aa2a57f.png]

questions.question: Notch used to bend the job at 90°
questions.solution:
Notches are the spaces provided for joining the edges when sheet metals are cut from the layout.

It helps to prevent surplus material from overlapping and causing a bulge at the seam and edges.

Types of notches:

 
• Straight notch or slit: Straight cuts made in the edge of the sheet where it is to be bent.
 
• Square notch: It is made when forming a rectangular or square box.
